svg.title: For completeness expand the finitely many pulled-back labels in fixed free bases. Write ck,A for the finite product of their coordinates and Wk,A for the corresponding mean basis moment at scaled positions; let c0,A, W0,A denote their limits. For every fixed position multi-index α and compact distinct set K, the exact finite expansion gives ∂α X (ck,AWk,A −c0,AW0,A) A
